 The achilles heel, is the string head snap holders, seem to be somewhat brittle, busted two heads less than 4 hours run time. Third head going strong 6 hours run time, tri-blade 7 hours run time, minimal wear.
Badger does not offer any pole attachments for this model  trimmer/cutter
Other wise the included tri-blade sliced through 1" coyote bush branches with ease
 Will recommend this machine BUT: probably look for third market trimmer heads

This tool clearly states in the listing that it does not use attachments and that it's primary purpose is for brush clearing. Results.ReviewText:
DO NOT BUY
I don’t recommend this product. I got this online and was only able to use it ones. The unit is so heavy that it broke the cheap harness that comes with it. So I took it back to the store, but I couldn’t return it because it passed the 90 day. I was given the online orders phone number. When I called them the person I spoke to blind transferred me to a voicemail. Still no call. I just want my money back and be done with all of this.

Also, it has a bad design. The weed wacker uses a different size and shape shaft so I can’t use any of my universal attachments, and there is no adapter available. Then there are the handlebars. It would have been better if they were offset. Since the handles are the same length it feels like you are always reaching for the right side. Furthermore, it is not designed for anyone shorter than 5’8”. The shaft is too long for proper use.

So I repeat DO NOT BUY!!!!!

311424784.Description: The Wild Badger Power 2-in-1 Straight Shaft Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer spool for detail work along fence lines and borders, as well as a brush cutter blade to tackle heavier grasses and thick brush. It also includes a harness coupled with ergonomic bicycle-style handles to relieve the strain on your arms and provide stability. Powered by a 52cc, 2-cycle, full-crank engine, your trimmer has plenty of power and is designed for reliability. The full crank design provides a smooth start and operation to reduce emissions, increase fuel efficiency and provide longer life. The transmission is supported by an aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube which is lightweight and durable for added comfort and convenience. The tap-and-go trimmer head allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
